title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE EVERYONE'S BANK BALANCE?

segments.line: One Monday morning, every person you look at has a number above their head.
It's everything they have. Every bank account, every savings account, minus every debt they owe.
It doesn't count cash under the mattress, or a house, or a car. Just money in the bank, and money owed.
Red if they owe more than they own.
And it updates live, to the cent.
Somebody taps a card, and you watch
the number drop. The rules are simple. You only see it in real life.
Not on TV, not in photos, not on video calls.
And no matter how hard you try, you can never see your own. Not in a mirror. Not
This is what if you could see everyone's bank balance.
